name: Trouble in Paradise
source:
You and your sister are moving to Paradise City for higher education. Both you and her are super excited when you finally move in together. The school is great, the people are friendly (and the girls are hot!) and everything seemed to be going well, until you discover something at school that changed your life forever! The game features unique characters with different personalities. Follow the life of a student, and experience friendships, romance, mystery, and a crapload of lewdness!

[From [url=https://syko134.itch.io/trouble-in-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和妹妹为了接受高等教育，搬到了天堂市。终于能够住在一起，你们都兴奋不已。学校很棒，人们十分友善，女孩子们也个个火辣！一切似乎都很顺利，直到你在学校发现了一件从此改变人生的事！游戏中有许多个性鲜明的独特角色。跟随一名学生的生活，体验友情、恋爱、谜团，以及多得数不清的色情情节！

[摘自[url=https://syko134.itch.io/trouble-in-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
